title: Mountain Miles Added for Touring Equipment Sold on a Car Rental
content:
Touring equipment sold on an agreement of the Car Rental Rate Classes adds a mountain allowance to the mileage granted on it. The equipment counted is the ski rack line and the snow chains line standing on the rental's ledger.

**The mountain schedule.**

| What stands on the rental's ledger | Miles added |
|---|---|
| Both a ski rack line and a snow chains line | 260 |
| One of a ski rack line or a snow chains line, but not both | 140 |
| Neither | Nothing on that account |

**The truth of the three rows.**

| Ski rack line | Snow chains line | Miles added |
|---|---|---|
| Stands | Stands | 260 |
| Stands | Does not stand | 140 |
| Does not stand | Stands | 140 |
| Does not stand | Does not stand | Nothing |

Only the two lines named count under this head. A rental carrying satellite navigation or child seats and neither of the two named lines has nothing added under it, and a rental carrying several ski rack lines and no snow chains line has 140 miles added, the schedule turning on whether a line of each kind stands rather than on how many stand.
